id./param/scenario/cs/a_150_cs_140.pack|cs_: Under the white cloth was hidden a picture of a beautiful mermaid.
"Grandpa painted this. She looks just like that mermaid, doesn't she?
"What's this? A letter?
"This is Grandpa's handwriting...
"'Dearest Beloved...
"'Ever since you saved me on the day of the great storm, the dream of being reunited with you is all I lived for.
"'But now I fear that dream is over. Forgive me, my darling, but I cannot keep my promise.
"'Some years after my exile, another great storm hit and many died, including the Kahuna and Leilani's husband.
"'Not long after, I saw a woman on the cliffs with a baby in her arms. It was Leilani, who was once to be my wife.
With her father and husband gone, she had lost all hope. I called out, but in her grief she could not hear me.
Before my disbelieving eyes, she threw herself into the ocean.
I tried to save them. I did everything I could, but only the baby survived.
Kai?
"You're sure you're fine to row back home? I wish you'd let me keep you till you're fighting fit.
Kainoa
Kainoa
"Don't worry about me, Michelle. You fixed me up real good. I'm fitter than ever!
"Kai, I know you've got things to do. Just promise you'll be back soon. I'll wait right here.
"Wah! WAAAH!!!
"(sob) Mmm... Waaah!
It's all my fault...
"I'm sorry, Michelle. I... I can't leave...
I can't just be thinking of myself any more. This child needs me...
"'The villagers say you cursed me, but they just don't understand. They don't want it to happen to anyone else.
"'Please forgive them. They don't know you like I do. What they don't know, they fear.
"'I sometimes wonder if you're still sitting on that rock, waiting for me to return...
"'But it's too late for me now. I'll understand if you can never forgive me, but I want you to know one thing:
"'I love you. I always will.'
"I'm sorry. I shouldn't have been so hard on you. Without you, I'd never have met Michelle...
